findings.issue: No blocking problems found. Minor: cnt_prior_week_same_type uses a min_periods=1 rolling mean, so it can rest on a single prior day. This is not leakage because the feature is shifted. Also, check_identity was run on only two of the many possible candidate triples, not all of them.
findings.why_it_matters: Low risk. The feature is shifted before it is aggregated. The same-type mean uses the forecast day's workday flag, which is known in advance.
